cards.title: 书生遇美女 | The Scholar Meets a Girl
cards.sentence: 一天晚上，王生在路上遇到了一个年轻的女孩。
cards.pinyin: Yì tiān wǎnshang, Wáng shēng zài lùshang yùdào le yí ge niánqīng de nǚhái.
cards.translation: One evening, Wang the scholar met a young girl on the road.

vocabList.translation: to run into; to come across

cards.title: 路边的哭声 | Crying by the Road
cards.sentence: 她一个人坐在路边哭，看起来很难过。
cards.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén zuò zài lùbiān kū, kàn qǐlái hěn nánguò.
cards.translation: She sat alone by the road, crying. She looked very sad.

cards.title: 无家可归 | Nowhere to Go
cards.sentence: 她说：“家里人要把我卖给别人，我只好跑出来了。”
cards.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Jiālǐ rén yào bǎ wǒ mài gěi biérén, wǒ zhǐhǎo pǎo chūlái le.”
cards.translation: She said, “My family wanted to sell me to someone else, so I had no choice but to run away.”

vocabList.translation: to have no choice but to

cards.title: 带回家 | A Stranger at Home
cards.sentence: 王生很担心她，就带她回了自己的家。
cards.pinyin: Wáng shēng hěn dānxīn tā, jiù dài tā huí le zìjǐ de jiā.
cards.translation: Wang worried about her, so he took her to his own home.

cards.title: 窗外的秘密 | The Secret at the Window
cards.sentence: 那天夜里，王生怎么也睡不着，他走到女孩的房间外面，从窗户往里看。
cards.pinyin: Nà tiān yè lǐ, Wáng shēng zěnme yě shuì bù zháo, tā zǒudào nǚhái de fángjiān wàimian, cóng chuānghu wǎng lǐ kàn.
cards.translation: That night, Wang couldn't fall asleep. He walked to the outside of the girl's room and looked in through the window.

cards.title: 06. Hidden Truth / 惊悚真面目
cards.sentence: 半夜里，他醒来一看，床上坐着一个面目可怕的鬼。
cards.pinyin: bànyè lǐ, tā xǐng lái yīkàn, chuáng shàng zuòzhe yīgè miànmù kěpà de guǐ.
cards.translation: In the middle of the night, he woke up and saw a terrifying ghost sitting on the bed.

cards.title: 07. The Painted Skin / 绘制人皮
cards.sentence: 桌上有一张画着美女的人皮，她正拿着笔在上面涂画。
cards.pinyin: zhuō shàng yǒuyī zhāng huàzhe měinǚ de rénpí, tā zhèng názhe bǐ zài shàngmiàn túhuà.
cards.translation: On the table was a human skin painted with the likeness of a beautiful woman, and she was painting on it with a brush.

cards.title: 08. Extreme Fear / 惊恐逃离
cards.sentence: 王生吓得差点晕过去，连衣服都来不及穿好就跑了出去。
cards.pinyin: wáng shēng xià de chàdiǎn yūn guòqù, lián yīfú dōu láibují chuān hǎo jiù pǎo le chūqù.
cards.translation: Mr. Wang was so scared that he almost fainted, and he ran out without even having time to put on his clothes properly.

cards.title: 09. Seeking Help / 寻找道士
cards.sentence: 为了保护家人，他决定去外面寻找有法力的道士帮忙。
cards.pinyin: wèile bǎohù jiārén, tā juédìng qù wàimiàn xúnzhǎo yǒu fālì de dàoshi bāngmáng.
cards.translation: In order to protect his family, he decided to go outside to look for a Taoist priest with magical powers for help.

cards.title: 10. The Priest's Advice / 道士授计
cards.sentence: 道士给了他一面特殊的镜子，并告诉他如何应对妖怪。
cards.pinyin: dàoshi gěi le tā yīmiàn tèshū de jìngzi, bìng gàosù tā rúhé yìngduì yàoguài.
cards.translation: The Taoist priest gave him a special mirror and told him how to deal with the monster.

cards.title: 11. The Confrontation / 正面交锋
cards.sentence: 回到家里，王生再次面对那个可怕的怪物，心中虽然害怕却很坚定。
cards.pinyin: huí dào jiālǐ, wáng shēng zàicì miànduì nàgè kěpà de guàiwù, xīnzhōng suīrán hàipà què hěn jiāndìng.
cards.translation: Returning home, Wang Sheng faced the terrifying monster once again; although he was afraid in his heart, he was very determined.

cards.title: 12. Resolution / 故事结局
cards.sentence: 最终，在道士的帮助下，邪恶的妖怪被收服，家里恢复了平静。
cards.pinyin: zuìzhōng, zài dàoshi de bāngzhù xià, xié'è de yàoguài bèi shōufú, jiālǐ huīfù le píngjìng.
cards.translation: In the end, with the help of the Taoist priest, the evil monster was subdued, and peace was restored to the home.
